mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% indicates weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sharp housing starts declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the Industrial Production Index above 1% signals stronger manufacturing activity and higher corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of restrictive monetary policy (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures exceeding 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sharp consumption declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating and impending policy tightening, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of very low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in GDP growth below 1% combined with a 2-month decline in Housing Starts exceeding 10% signals weakening demand and reduced corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak GDP growth and housing starts declines (t-test p > 0.05).
